derived.method: CalPERS shares ÷ shares outstanding, all classes (374,740 ÷ (402,714,357 Class A + 19,640,250 Class B) = 374,740 ÷ 422,354,607)

inputs.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, cover page
inputs.quote: As of October 25, 2026, the registrant had 402,714,357 and 19,640,250 shares of class A common stock and class B common stock outstanding, respectively.

inputs.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, share class rights
inputs.quote: Holders of class A common stock generally have the same rights, including rights to dividends, as holders of class B common stock, except that holders of class A common stock have one vote per share while holders of class B common stock have ten votes per share.

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: As of February 13, 2026, there were approximately 762 stockholders of record of our class A common stock and two stockholders of record of our class B common stock.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); NBIM now lists it as "Strategy Inc". CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issuer 'STRATEGY INC' (formerly MicroStrategy; same CUSIP 594972408). Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS holds class A; the denominator is class A plus class B from the Q3 2026 10-Q cover at October 25, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record: class A only; class B has two holders of record.
